narrative.overview:
Novatalis Lens is drawn as a measuring instrument. Every mark on the screen is a reading: a figure, a date, a bar, a tick. The chrome is two dark surfaces and a hairline, and it carries no hue at all. Colour is spent only where it encodes something: the direction of a move, how far a compound is from market, which FDA book a product sits in, and whether a value still needs review. The stylesheet says it in its own words: "an instrument, not a landing page".

The system is dense and flat. A full tab fits one 1440 px screen with little scrolling, at a 14 px base with most labels between 9.5 and 12.5 px. Sections are separated by a rule and a caps label, never by a card. Three type roles do three separate jobs: Archivo for structure, IBM Plex Mono for anything measured, and Newsreader for the one thing that is written rather than computed, the analyst note.

One surface breaks the density on purpose: the front door. It is a single wheel of three drawn motifs, one per engine, with the NOVATALIS wordmark and no figures. Everything behind it is the instrument.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only. Deep petrol ground, one raised panel tone, hairlines in three weights.
Hue means something or it is absent. Chrome is neutral.
Square corners. Radius is 0, or 2 px on small controls.
Figures in tabular mono so columns hold when values refresh.
A missing value is drawn as missing (a dash, a hatch, a broken line), never as zero.
Every chart is a hand-built SVG from the token set.

rules.name: The Two Files Rule
rules.body: A colour or spacing value is written in `frontend/assets/tokens.css` and `frontend/components/tokens.py` and nowhere else. A test keeps the two in step. Everything else reads a token or a `color-mix()` of tokens.

rules.name: The Second Signal Rule
rules.body: Colour is never the only signal. Every coloured mark also carries a label, a glyph or a position. A down chip draws its own triangle; a phase colour sits beside the phase name.

rules.name: The Spoken-For Rule
rules.body: A hue that already means something is not borrowed for something else. Amber is "filed" on the phase ramp and "needs review" everywhere else, which is why a panel vote takes ochre and the biotech engine got its own orange.

rules.name: The Measured In Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything measured or identified is Plex Mono with tabular lining numerals: figures, tickers, dates, application numbers. A negative uses a true minus (U+2212), not a hyphen.

rules.name: The One Written Voice Rule
rules.body: Newsreader is for prose a person wrote or the note engine composed. It never sets a label, a heading or a figure.

rules.name: The Caps Are Labels Rule
rules.body: Uppercase belongs to section labels, micro labels, tickers and marker letters. A sentence, a headline and a money figure keep their own case.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: A section is a rule and a caps label, never a card. Structure comes from `rule-strong`; rows and grids from `rule`; the mesh behind dense data from `rule-faint`.

dos: Do take every colour from a token or a `color-mix()` of tokens, and add a new token to both `tokens.css` and `tokens.py` when a new meaning needs one.
Do pair every use of colour with a label, a glyph or a position.
Do set figures, tickers, dates and identifiers in IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals, right-aligned in tables, with a true minus.
Do draw a missing value as missing: a dash in Slate, a hatched band, a broken line. State why in place where the reason is known ("no free data").
Do open a section with a hairline and a caps label, and put the period its figures cover in the boxed basis tag when two sections on a page differ.
Do build charts through `frontend/components/charts.py` as inline SVG.

Do set `font-family` on the class of any text injected through Streamlit markdown. Streamlit's markdown container sets its own face, so a class that relies on inheriting Archivo from the page renders in Streamlit's default sans.
Do keep the focus ring and honour `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't write a colour literal or a spacing constant outside the two token files.
Don't use a radius above 2 px. Streamlit's native segmented control still ships its own rounded corners; the house segmented control is square with 2 px outer corners.
Don't wrap a section in a card or give a resting surface a shadow.
Don't spend hue on chrome. A button, a border or a heading that is green, amber or red is making a claim about data.
Don't reuse a hue that already carries a meaning for a second meaning.
Don't plot a null as zero.
Don't set labels, headings or figures in Newsreader, or prose in mono.
Don't use native Streamlit or Altair charts. A chart rendered inside a hidden Streamlit tab is measured at a few pixels and collapses.
Don't design a light theme against this file. The light palette in `theme.py` is kept for tests only; the running app is always dark.
